title: Stolen cymbals, sock cymbal and an old pedal
summary: His cymbals were stolen at the American Legion Hall; he talks about cowbell, wood block and wanting an old foot pedal.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: That's the sizzle, I call it a sizzle symbol sometimes, don't they? Right, right. It's like little rivets in there, isn't it? Yeah. Yeah, about a dozen, there are about eight little rivets in there. That's the turn. Let's see what make that is. That's a nice Turkish one, sounds good. I was wondering if it's one of the ziljins. I don't use a sizzle, do I have it? Abanis sent me a sock signal, Turkish signal. Boy, what happened about the sock signal? And I played at the American Legion Hall. Oh, somebody else at the door. I had a sock signal when I went back that night. Someone stole it. Oh. Where? The American Legion Hall down here on Royal? Royal Street. Mm-hmm. And they stole all my symbols. Went to the police and all, never did part. Was anybody much used in the old days? Did they use the sock symbol very much? When did that come out? In the old days, never did they use the sock symbol. You didn't even know what sock symbol was. You see, you're up. That wood block reminds me of that's rather just a small... Yeah. About the...
That one's an eighties I built.

Seven inch block. You only use one cowbell now, do you? Yes, sir. About a five inch cowbell. Five inch cowbell. Got them mounted right on the same stand. That's a nice drum set. Do you know anybody that has one of those old pedals anymore? Where we could find anybody that might have one of those old... No, I would like to borrow. A lot of people I know would like to have one. I'd like to borrow. Really.
You think you'd use it again, Allie?

No, I wouldn't use it again, but I'd just keep it. Yeah. The old keepsake, I'd like to have one. Yeah. But I'm going to see a guy, and if I do... I'll let you know, Mr. Russell. If you find an extra one, I wouldn't want to take one of you... One of yourself, but sometimes... If you find one where I could buy one, I'd sure be glad to get one too. You have everything in two cases. Your base drum and everything else goes in one case then, does it? I'm at a job, I'm supposed to play tonight, I don't know. I never went to the guy yet, they're supposed to get it. I don't know where it's on me, I think. There's a Chinese symbol over there, too.
